FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

A gentle graduation: three mini-puzzles that revisit the class’s core skills. Celebrate each one — the third click earns the applause.

Prefer paper? The Logic Castle Graduation worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
